idea-plugin.name: shadowenv
idea-plugin.description:
shadowenv

Compiled with Java 1.8

GitHub | Issues

Shadowenv is a plugin for JetBrains IDEs that evalutes shadowenv before running a Run Configuration, and sets any environment variables that should be set. It will also attempt to set your SDK version to match what shadowenv wants.

Supported Platforms:

  • PyCharm
  • IDEA
  • RubyMine
  • GoLand
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.0.3:
  • Security: environment variable values are no longer written to the IDE log.
  • Fixed: variables that shadowenv unsets are removed, instead of failing the run configuration.
0.0.2:
  • Fixed: no empty argument is passed to shadowenv hook.
0.0.1:
  • Initial release of shadowenv with support for env var settings and Ruby SDK updating. Also supports NVM
